text: src/tools/seam_index.py — Python CLI tool that extracts cross-component join keys (HTTP endpoints, bus topics, DB tables, env vars) from a source tree using regex patterns; no model involved, deterministic output

docs/src/tools/seam_index.py.md — Markdown documentation for src/tools/seam_index.py, covering overview, symbols (7), dependencies (5), side effects (4), and security surface (4); generated by the File Documenter agent 2026-10-02

.aee/changed-files.json — Repo Checker manifest tracking added/modified/deleted files under src/ since the last run; beforeSha is null on first run, then carries forward as the comparison baseline for subsequent runs
.aee/security-log.jsonl — per-file security analysis summary (file, findingCount, criticalCount, highCount, analyzedAt); skipped files carry skipped:true and skipReason
.aee/intake.jsonl — File Intake Classifier log; one JSON line per file with fields: file, hash, language, component, batch, arrivedAt; skipped files carry skipped:true
.aee/intake-summary.md — human-readable summary produced by the File Intake Classifier after each run: counts per language and component, skip count, and UNKNOWN files flagged for human review
.aee/link-graph.json — Relationship Linker output; top-level keys: resolved, ambiguous, unresolved, crossComponentSeams; written each run when the seam or reference sets change
.aee/link-summary.md — human-readable Relationship Linker summary: reference counts, cross-component seams with join keys, unresolved references table, and open-end report when delivery is partial

docs/components/ — Synthesizer output directory: one Markdown file per component (Overview, File Inventory, Defined Symbols, External Dependencies, Side Effects, Component Diagram, Local Data Flow, Cross-Component Interfaces) plus index.md listing all components

.aee/security-chains.json — Cross-File Security Correlator output; array of confirmed and partial taint chains, each with chainId, source, hops (file+lineRange+symbol+crossComponent), sink, owaspCategory, cweId, severity, confidence, severityUpgraded, and sanitisationGaps fields

.aee/security-chains-summary.md — human-readable summary of security chains: confirmed/partial counts, severity breakdown, cross-component seam note, and per-chain source→sink table with OWASP/CWE columns
